login.title: Admin Panel
login.lead: Sign in with your account to manage the site content.

errors.notConfigured: Sign-in has not been configured yet. Please contact the site administrator.
errors.unknown: Could not connect. Please try again.

overview.title: Welcome
overview.lead: You are signed in as <0>{{email}}</0>. The site's dynamic content is managed from this panel.

modules.title: Content sections
modules.empty: No manageable sections have been added yet. They will appear here and in the side menu as they are added.

gallery.title: Photo Gallery
gallery.lead: Add, edit and delete the photos shown on the site's gallery page.

status.empty: There are no photos in the gallery yet. Start by uploading the first one.

form.dropHint: Drag a photo here or choose one. JPEG, PNG, WebP; up to 40 MB. It is resized automatically before upload.
form.textHint: Title and description are optional. If the English text is empty, the Turkish text is shown on the English site.

delete.title: Delete this photo?
delete.body: The photo will be permanently removed from the gallery and the server. This cannot be undone.

errors.storageNotConfigured: Photo storage has not been configured yet. Please contact the site administrator.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Refresh the page and sign in again.
errors.tooLarge: The file is too large. Choose a photo up to 40 MB.
errors.unreadable: This file could not be read. Try a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
errors.uploadIncomplete: The upload could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.notFound: Photo not found; it may have been deleted in another session.
errors.unknown: The action could not be completed. Check your connection and try again.

certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.lead: Add, edit and delete the certificates and documents shown on the site's Certificates page.

status.empty: No certificates have been uploaded yet. Start by uploading the first one.

form.dropHint: Drag a scan or photo of the certificate here or choose one. JPEG, PNG, WebP; up to 40 MB. It is resized automatically while keeping the text legible.
form.textHint: Title and description are optional (e.g. title: the document's name, description: its scope and issuing body). If the English text is empty, the Turkish text is shown on the English site.

delete.title: Delete this certificate?
delete.body: The certificate will be permanently removed from the site and the server. This cannot be undone.

errors.storageNotConfigured: Image storage has not been configured yet. Please contact the site administrator.

errors.unreadable: This file could not be read. Try a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
